body:
Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
NZ格式路径中 offsetA_ 的batch偏移量使用 batchBOffset 而非 batchAOffset（aTrans和非aTrans两个分支都有）

### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
910B
### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
ND路径(L208)正确用batchAOffset，NZ路径copy-paste时错误用了batchBOffset。当batchA==batchB时bug被掩盖。
### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
NZ格式路径中 offsetA_ 的batch偏移量使用 batchAOffset（aTrans和非aTrans两个分支都有）
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
quant_batch_matmul_v3/op_kernel/quant_batch_matmul_v3.h:214,219
### Special notes for this issue/备注 (Optional / 选填)
            
https://gitcode.com/zhengshencn_hwca/ops-nn/blob/matmul_full_scan/matmul/mat_mul_batch_invariant/SCAN_FINDINGS_CACHE.md
